app.name: YaatraGo
app.tagline: A trusted travel companion that helps you plan your journey, stay connected, and confirm that you arrived safely.

onboarding.step1Text: Save where you are going and when you expect to arrive.
onboarding.step2Text: Let the people you trust know when you have reached safely.
onboarding.step3Text: Use the SOS button in an emergency. The app always shows what was actually confirmed.
onboarding.privacy: YaatraGo asks for location only when you choose to share it.

auth.signinText: Sign in to plan journeys and keep your safety routine close.
auth.createText: Start with a calm, simple safety routine.
auth.demoNotice: Demo mode is on. Your account stays on this device and does not connect to a server.
auth.realUnavailable: Sign in is unavailable until a verified backend is connected.

home.headline: Where are you heading?
home.subhead: Plan a journey so reaching safely is simple to confirm.
home.contactsHint: Add people only when the server can securely manage their consent and contact details.
home.arrivalText: You are past the expected arrival time. Please let us know how your journey is going.

journey.newText: Add the essentials first. Transfers are optional.
journey.transferText: Only add a transfer if it helps you remember the plan.
journey.routeDemo: Demo route preview. Live maps and route estimates need a verified map provider.
journey.permissionText: Your browser may show your location while this page is open. It may stop when the browser is closed or suspended.
journey.addRoutine: Creating routines needs a verified backend.
journey.locationReady: Current location is available in this browser.
journey.locationUnavailable: Location is unavailable. You can continue without sharing it.

arrival.title: Have you reached safely?
arrival.text: Confirm when you arrive. An overdue journey is not treated as proof of danger.
arrival.travellingText: Your journey will remain in progress in this demo.
arrival.confirmedText: This demo journey is now marked complete. No one was notified.

sos.title: Get help
sos.text: Choose a reason so the request is clear. Only use SOS when you need help now.
sos.confirmText: In demo mode, this will only show the status here. It will not contact a person or service.
sos.receivedText: This is a demo request. No trusted contact, emergency service, or Telegram message was contacted.
sos.activeText: Stay in a public, staffed, or well-lit place if you can. Call local emergency services if you are in immediate danger.
sos.resolvedText: This demo SOS has been marked resolved.

contacts.title: Trusted people
contacts.text: The people you want informed about your journey.
contacts.notConnectedText: No verified contacts endpoint is available. Demo contacts are shown only to explain the experience.
contacts.name: Name
contacts.deleteText: This removes the demo contact from this device.

assistant.title: Safety Assistant
assistant.disclaimer: The assistant does not contact people or emergency services and does not know your location unless you share it.
assistant.welcome: Tell me what is happening. If you are in immediate danger, move toward a public place and use SOS or call local emergency services.
assistant.fallback: I can help you think through the next safe step. If you feel unsafe now, move toward people or staff and use SOS.

settings.title: Settings
settings.voiceText: Voice features use your browser when available.
settings.privacyText: Location is requested only after you choose to share it. Browser location may not work in the background.
settings.serverHint: For another laptop on your network, use its local IP and port after the backend enables CORS for this app.
settings.connectionUnknown: No verified health endpoint is available, so a server test cannot confirm service health.
settings.aboutText: YaatraGo helps you plan a journey, stay connected, and confirm that you reached safely.
settings.guidedTourText: Plan a journey, keep it open while travelling, and confirm arrival. SOS is separate and intentional.
settings.localDataText: Clear demo account and local preferences from this device.

activity.title: Activity
activity.text: Journey and safety activity appears here.

common.unavailable: This feature is not connected to a verified backend.
common.voiceUnsupported: Voice input is not supported in this browser.
